pathParams.name: JournalEntryId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the journal entry to update

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the journal entry

attributes.name: EntryDate
attributes.description: The date the journal entry was created. Valid format is "YYYY-MM-DD" e.g. "2022-03-03".

attributes.name: LineItems
attributes.description: Array of line-item objects. Two or more line-item objects must be passed to create a journal entry. The sum of the total debits must equal the total credits for all line-item objects.

attributes.name: Credit
attributes.description: The credit amount. Total debits and credits must be equal. For example, if line-item 1 has a credit of "10.00", line-item 2 must have a debit of "10.00".

attributes.name: Debit
attributes.description: The debit amount. Total debits and credits must be equal. For example, if line-item 1 has a credit of "10.00", line-item 2 must have a debit of "10.00".

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: A brief, informative description of the journal entry's line item

attributes.name: GlAccountId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the general ledger account associated with the journal entry line item

attributes.name: PropertyId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the property or association related to the journal entry

attributes.name: Remarks
attributes.description: A description or summary of the journal entry

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated journal entry
